title: Lyric Loom
description: A cloth woven from printed cotton tapes, every thread a line from a late-night set. Pull it and the threads stretch toward your hand row by row, the weave opening onto warm light behind; let go and it settles back, or flick it and a ripple runs through.
intent: Type as woven material: real over-under interlacing of lyric tapes on spring chains with mass, so a pull opens the cloth onto backlight and a flick travels through it.
